evidence.reason: The alleged bypass depends on systemd treating NUL as a line boundary in v255 unit/config input. It does not: `read_line_full()` rejects a NUL byte in non-tty input with `-EINVAL` (unless the specific `READ_LINE_ONLY_NUL` flag is set, which unit parsing does not use), so systemd will not read a separate `TimeoutStartSec=` assignment after an apparent comment line containing NUL. The described allowlist bypass and preflight-bound invalidation therefore cannot occur; rejecting NUL would be hardening rather than fixing the asserted defect.
